# Modern Physics

Welcome to the Modern Physics course page.

## Course description

This course introduces the main ideas of modern physics, including special relativity, quantum mechanics, atomic physics, and selected applications.

## Course materials

- Syllabus
- Lecture slides
- Problem sets
- Laboratory guides
- Additional readings

## Topics

1. Special relativity
2. Blackbody radiation
3. Photoelectric effect
4. Compton effect
5. Introduction to quantum mechanics
6. Schrödinger equation
7. Hydrogen atom
8. Atomic and nuclear physics
